Bike shops in San Francisco: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in San Francisco that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

Bike shops in San Francisco: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Columbus Cyclery

    2011 Mason Street, San Francisco, CA 94133 · (415) 561-9999

    repairship-to-shoprentalrental-roadrental-mtbrental-ebike

    Zone 6, North Beach, about 1.6 miles north of City Hall; the shop says the Wharf and the bike path to the bridge are a few minutes away. The one confirmed ship-to-shop: ship the bike here and they build and tune it in 24 to 48 hours for $135 ($190 for an e-bike), and box it for the trip home for $115, or $135 with accessories (Oct 2026). Open every day, 10 to 6. Walk-in repair, no appointment, 24 to 48 hours; flat fix $16 labor. It does not service tubeless or tubular tires. Rents what it calls race bikes at $59 a day or $50 a day for three days or more (Oct 2026); no model or size is listed. Its rental page also lists mountain and electric bikes.

  2. Sports Basement Presidio

    610 Old Mason Street, San Francisco, CA 94129 · (415) 934-2900

    repairsame-dayfittingrentalrental-roadrental-gravelrental-mtbrental-ebikebox-rental

    Zone 1, the Presidio, the closest pick to the bridge and to the Lodge at the Presidio. Rents carbon road bikes (Cannondale Synapse or Scott Addict 30, Shimano 105 or better, 44 to 61 cm) and a Cannondale Topstone Carbon gravel bike (XS to XL): $100 a day, $175 for 2 to 4 days, $300 for 5 to 9 days (Oct 2026). A Synapse Hi-Mod Dura-Ace (51 to 61 cm) is $135, $220 and $380. Helmet, lock and flat kit come with it. Pedals aren't mentioned, so bring yours. A $1,000 hold goes on a physical credit card with matching ID. Reserve online and pick up here, or at the Stonestown or Berkeley stores. Open every day, weekdays 10 to 8 and weekends 9 to 7. The service desk does small jobs and flats on the spot. GURU fit $300. Rents a Thule RoundTrip bike case at $55 a day, $80 for 2 to 4 days or $110 for 5 to 9 days (Oct 2026).

  3. High Trails Cyclery

    1825 Polk Street, San Francisco, CA 94109 · (415) 814-3216

    repairrentalrental-roadrental-gravelrental-mtbrental-ebike

    Zone 6, Polk Gulch below Russian Hill, about a mile north of City Hall. Rents a carbon road bike with hydraulic discs (Cervelo Caledonia or similar, 48 to 61 cm) at $100 a day and a gravel bike (Cervelo Aspero or similar, 48 to 58 cm) at $125 a day. Pedals of your choice (flat, SPD, SPD-SL or Look Keo), cage, helmet and lock come free (prices read Oct 2026). Opens late: Monday to Friday noon to 6, Saturday 10 to 4, closed Sunday. Its mechanics work on Di2, eTap AXS and Campagnolo; safety check $60, tune-up $180 (Oct 2026). The rental page's images date from May 2024, so call to confirm the fleet and prices.

  4. Valencia Cyclery

    1065 Valencia St., San Francisco, CA 94110 · (415) 550-6601

    repairsame-day

    Zone 6, the Mission, about 1.6 miles south of City Hall and about a mile from the Castro start of Different Spokes' Jersey Ride (2nd Saturday of the month, 8:45 am). Repairs are walk-in only, and most simple jobs are done the same day; Level 1 service is $160 (Oct 2026). Monday to Saturday 10 to 6, Sunday 10 to 5. Boxes a bike for BikeFlights from $120; allow four business days between drop-off and pickup (Oct 2026). Its site doesn't say it receives a shipped bike. Use the repair shop at 1065; the sales floor is next door at 1077, (415) 550-6600.

  5. Mike's Bikes of Sausalito

    #1 Gate 6 Rd., Sausalito, CA 94965 · (415) 332-3200

    repair

    Zone 2, the Marin City end of Sausalito, about 8 miles north of City Hall, at the start of the Mill Valley-Sausalito bike path (the shop's words), and the start of the short version of Different Spokes' Jersey Ride (2nd Saturday of the month, 8:45 am). Service is open every day; appointments are encouraged and walk-ins are welcome. Monday to Saturday 10 to 6, Sunday 10 to 5. The chain's NorCal price list has a tube or tire install at $15 labor (Oct 2026). This store doesn't rent bikes; the chain's demo and rental fleet in Marin is at Mike's Bikes of San Rafael.

  6. Splitrock Tap & Wheel

    2020 Sir Francis Drake Blvd., Fairfax, CA 94930 · (415) 721-7644

    repairrentalrental-mtbrental-ebikecoffee

    Zone 2, Fairfax, about 17 miles north-northwest of City Hall; a bike shop with a café and taproom, and the start of Marin Cyclists' Point Reyes Station ride (Saturdays, 8:45 am). The shop is open every day, 10 to 6; the café runs 11 a.m. to 8:30 or 9 p.m. Rents full-suspension, hardtail and electric trail bikes for a half day or 24 hours; no prices on the site. Walk-ins are taken, but reserve to get your size. Tune-up $150 (Oct 2026). The business filed for Chapter 11 in April 2026 and said it will keep operating (WhatNow, April 14, 2026), so call before you count on it.
